from_speaker: not one person outside of OpenAI
our_interpretation: This concerns evaluations completed by publication on December 21, 2024, including earlier private evaluations. The beginning of that historical lookback is unspecified.
In context, robustness across different problem types means testing whether reliable performance extends across meaningfully different domains.
Merely evaluating different puzzles within ARC does not, on this reading, establish a cross-domain robustness evaluation.
The claim concerns whether testing occurred, not merely whether a report had been published.
criteria.support_condition: Comprehensive access and evaluation records establish that no external person had completed a cross-domain robustness evaluation by publication.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented external evaluation completed by publication tests o3's reliability across meaningfully different problem domains.
